## About
Jackpot Auto Dismantling sells quality used parts to drivers and mechanics around Los Angeles. You can search the inventory online before you make the trip.
Customers know Sam and his team for being direct. One reviewer put it simply: no time wasting. Rated 4.3 on Google from 26 reviews.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used auto parts for the Los Angeles area.
- Search Inventory: Look up parts online before you come in. Search by image or run a multi-part search.
- Multi-Part Search: Look for more than one part at a time.

## FAQ
Q: Can I check if you have my part before I come in?
A: Yes. Search the inventory on the website. One customer found the part online and came in to buy it.

Q: Is the online price the price at the shop?
A: One reviewer said the price online is the price you get at the shop.
